units: km, s, kg, N; impulses explicitly m/s
purpose: Teaching examples; no real spacecraft performance assumed.

assumptions.fixed: apogee and perigee radii, original plane
assumptions.free: argument of pericentre, final phase and final time
assumptions.repair: retrograde at next perigee, prograde at next apogee
assumptions.optimality: not optimized; cost belongs to this prescribed repair

abort.reference: fully completed finite burn (separate from impulsive delay target)
abort.orbits_compared: osculating orbit geometry at each cutoff, not simultaneous positions
